entries.en: @-mention: Add ~/.claude/\* files to suggestions for easier agent, output style, and slash command editing
entries.zh: @-mention：将 ~/.claude/\* 文件添加到建议中，以便更轻松地进行代理、输出样式和斜杠命令编辑

entries.en: Use built-in ripgrep by default; to opt out of this behavior, set USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0
entries.zh: 默认使用内置的 ripgrep；如需关闭，请设置 `USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0`

entries.en: Fix tool_use/tool_result id mismatch error when network is unstable
entries.zh: 修复网络不稳定时 tool_use/tool_result id 不匹配的错误

entries.en: Fix Claude sometimes ignoring real-time steering when wrapping up a task
entries.zh: 修复克劳德在完成任务时有时会忽略实时转向的问题
